cecilia: 🚀 Heads-up — Sparrow-batcher v3 is live in hosted and dedicated (us-east-1, eu-west-1).
Short summary: p50 token latency -2.8ms, p99 token latency -24ms, average token cost -16% across webchat workloads. Low-risk rollout, more details below. :tada:

ishaan: awesome — what scope did you roll? can we flip it to default?

sam: congrats! how are we measuring the cost delta? any regressions on long sequences (>1024)?

cecilia: ran an A/B against production traffic (test id: sparrow-v3-prod-2026-03). Start 08:00–12:00 UTC, ramp 5% -> 50% canary -> promoted. No statistically significant regressions on seq>1024 in the sample. Cost measured by per-token infer CPU/GPU cycles + effective token batching wins. Baseline: sparrow-v2.

ops-bot: Deploybot: Sparrow-batcher-v3 promoted to 100% in us-east-1 at 09:45 UTC. Release note: infra/sparrow/v3

laura: nice. did we change eviction behavior for the KV prefix cache?

cecilia: we adjusted eviction preference to prefer prefix affinity; net effect: slightly higher cache hit_rate on short dialogs, minimal added memory pressure. Config snippet: ```
batcher:
  name: sparrow_v3
  coalesce_window_ms: 6
  max_batch_tokens: 4096
  prefer_prefix_cache: true
  adaptive_evict_threshold: 0.85
```

sam: can you share the reproduction command? i'd like to run microbench locally.

cecilia: sure — quick repro: ```
./runtest --suite=sparrow-latency --model=redwood-base-4k --qps=200 --seq=512 --dur=300
```

jordan: adding to release notes + perf bench index. also will update the cost-impact section in the billing dashboard (tag: sparrow_v3).

laura: huge thanks to infra & perf teams. 🎉 :clap:

ishaan: can we watch p99 for low-traffic / tail models? schedule a check in 2 hours?

cecilia: scheduled. monitor jobs: `perf-alert:sparrow_v3_p99` every 15m, compare to baseline. I pinged @oncall.

ops-bot: Oncall: perf check scheduled at 11:30 UTC (job id perf-2777777012).

cecilia: Will post a short postmortem/bench writeup tomorrow with detailed numbers and the A/B dashboard link. If you spot any anomalies ping me or @eng-sre.

sam: thanks all. can we capture the runbook change for rollback? quick note: rollback is `infra-promote sparrow_v2 --region $REGION` — requires infra-sudo.

cecilia: added rollback cmd to the release doc.

laura: LGTM, marking for release notes and customer comms prep.

ishaan: :rocket:
